caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair viewed from the front, centered on a plain, light-colored background. The chair features four horizontal slats forming the backrest, each with a slight curve and rendered in shades of yellowish-brown with wood grain detail. The chair has two vertical uprights on either side, with turned, spindle-like ornamentation, and topped by finials. Curved armrests extend from the uprights, attaching to the seat, and are similarly colored and shaded. The seat is woven, with a pattern of diagonal stripes in yellow and green, forming four triangular sections that meet at the center. The front legs are also turned and cylindrical, matching the overall style, with horizontal stretchers connecting the legs and providing additional support. The artist’s signature “E. Schwabe” is visible in the lower right corner. The overall color palette consists of shades of yellow, light brown, and muted green on an off-white background.
title: Armchair
